species: The peptide spectra were searched against the P. falciparum database to identify proteins associated with PfMed31.
tissue: 6 mL of infected blood (>10% parasitemia, 2% hematocrit) was harvested for the experiment.
cell_type: For western blot analysis, parasites were released from infected erythrocytes by 0.1% saponin treatment and lysed using 50–200 μL of the parasite lysis buffer
disease_state: The genome of the human malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum has been predicted to encode several Mediator subunits.
sample_source: This research involved the use of human blood drawn from healthy volunteers by trained healthcare professionals
cell_line: the wild-type T996 parent strain as a negative control to rule out nonspecific interactions
strain: P. falciparum T996 strain parasites were cultured at 2% hematocrit in RPMI 1640 medium
